rows.en: Nyan-Nyan! I've been there before!!
Their maguro buns are delicious, aren't they...

Before we start getting hungry, we're off
to my secret favorite spot!
So your secret favorite spot was Griffith Park.

The sunset you can see from here
is my very favorite.

Looking at this view, all your tiredness
just blows away, doesn't it?

The breeze feels so nice...
You're really right.

Do you know the city a little better now?
I'm not much of a tour guide, though.
Yes, it really helped a lot.
I'm glad. Well then, shall we head home?
(We walked around a lot, but it was fun.)

(So, where should I go today?
I could head out somewhere far... Having tea
wouldn't be bad either.)
rows.notes: Dropped the full-width indent space at the start of line 2.

rows.en: (Hmm, what should I do...)

\p-chan,
what's up? Why are you looking all around
like that out here?
Oh, Claire-senpai! Hello!

Mm-hm, I just love that energy.
So, is something the matter?

I was thinking of going somewhere, but...
I don't really know this city very well...
All right!
You will, Claire-senpai?

Sooner or later you'll be dropping in here
after school too. Their sweets are delicious.
Ooh~ Sweets, huh~

If you don't have anyone to go with,
I'll join you for a cup of tea.

(Hmm, no matter how I look at it, this is Deep
Akihabara... Claire-senpai sure gets around...)
rows.notes: Deep Akihabara is provisional in the glossary.

rows.en:
Deep Akihabara's near Shibuya, right?
And in Shibuya, if I remember right...
rows.notes: Deep Akihabara is provisional in the glossary.

rows.en: (We walked around a lot, but it was fun.)
(What should I do today~)

Oh, \p-kun.
Are you lost again today?

C-Claire-senpai!
That's not it. Geez.
Just kidding. What were you up to?
I was just thinking about what to do.

Hmm, is that so...
Then why don't you hang out with your big sis
again today?
rows.notes: Claire calls herself onee-san; 'your big sis' as in c00580.

rows.en: Really?! Yes!!
Hehehe, let's go~ Follow me!

Today was fun again, wasn't it?
Let's hang out together again sometime.
Okay, see you next time!
(That was a nice change of pace.)

\p-chan.
Are you lost again today?

C-Claire-senpai!
It's nothing like that! Geez!
Really?! Yaaay!!
Okaaay!
Yes, of course!

(I'm supposed to do some training on my own
with Claire-senpai today, but...)
Senpai sure is late...

\p-kun,
sorry I'm late. Did I keep you waiting?
Oh my, aren't you sweet.
Wh-what? I didn't mean anything by it!
Oh? You're blushing. How cute.
Please don't tease me, Senpai.
Hehehe.
Running's good for today, right?
(Is Senpai nervous or something?)

(It was supposed to be a simple run...
How did it come to this...)
Umm, should we run a little slower...?

Hah, hah, hah...
...Please......
*pant* *pant* *pant*...
Are you okay?
...Looks like you're not okay.
You're not good at exercise, are you?

*pant* *pant* *pant*...
...Just a little.
I don't think that's just 'a little'...
What's that? Got a complaint, kouhai-kun?
rows.notes: Claire's koukai-kun: 'junior' as Klan's koukai in c01480, with the -kun she attaches kept. Review: Claire's kouhai-kun/-chan kept as 'kouhai-kun'/'kouhai-chan', like -senpai.

rows.en: N-no, not really...
Good. Honesty is a virtue!
In that case, let's switch to walking.
Hmph, bring it on!
Sigh... That's nothing to brag about.

(I didn't get any of my own training done,
but it was nice to see an unexpected side
of Claire-senpai.)

\p-chan,
sorry I'm late. Did I keep you waiting?
I just got here myself, so it's fine.
Ehehe...

Look at you, blushing!
Geez, you're just too cute!!
I-I can't breathe, Senpai...
rows.notes: Slurred kurushii: Claire is hugging her too tightly.

rows.en: Ahaha, I got carried away...
Fwaah...

Phew...
Well then, let's get going.
Running's good for today, right?
(It was supposed to be a simple run...)

I kind of feel like that's way more
than 'a little'...
What's that? Got a complaint, kouhai-chan?
rows.notes: Claire's kouhai-chan: 'junior' with the -chan she attaches kept (male version: junior-kun). Review: Claire's kouhai-kun/-chan kept as 'kouhai-kun'/'kouhai-chan', like -senpai.

rows.en: Mm-hm, I just adore honest girls!!

uncertain: c04288/c04306: Claire's 'kouhai-kun' / 'kouhai-chan' rendered 'junior-kun' / 'junior-chan' (junior as Klan's kouhai in c01480; the honorific she attaches kept). Same in c04365/c04384 (slice 58).
c04269: jishu-tore rendered 'training on my own', as the finished slices (c22258, c22975).
c04258: Claire's onee-san rendered 'your big sis' as in c00580.
c04263: kibun tenkan here is the ordinary phrase 'a nice change of pace', not the schedule command 'Outing'.
Deep Akihabara (c04250, c04251) is provisional in locations.json.
